outline: This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the approximation of internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  and the calculation of spot rate curves via the bootstrap method.
